questions.question_text: In a computer-based HSK exam, what should you do after the listening section ends?
options: You can keep answering listening questions.
You must remove your headphones immediately.
You are not allowed to answer listening or writing questions during the reading section.
You should wait for the proctor to give you paper.
questions.explanation: Exam rules state that cross-section answering is prohibited, meaning you cannot work on listening or writing tasks while in the reading section.

questions.question_text: If a candidate arrives after the listening section starts but before it finishes for a paper-based exam, what is the rule?
options: They can enter immediately and start the test.
They can only enter after the listening section is completed, with no extra time granted.
They are allowed to take the test only if they pay an extra fee.
They will be given double time to complete the test.
questions.explanation: According to the exam procedures, late arrivals are only permitted entry after the listening section ends and no time compensation is given.

questions.question_text: What is the primary method of conducting the HSK Speaking test?
questions.explanation: The HSK Speaking Test is officially conducted through audio recording.

questions.question_text: During a computer-based exam, are candidates allowed to listen to audio while reading writing tasks?
questions.explanation: Computer-based exams forbid cross-section answering; you must only work on the specific section designated.

questions.question_text: What must you do after finishing the listening section in a computer-based HSK exam?
questions.explanation: Candidates must follow the system and invigilator's flow and cannot jump ahead to other sections.

questions.question_text: What is the rule for headphone use during the HSK Speaking test?
options: Only used during the first minute
questions.explanation: Candidates are required to wear headphones for the duration of the oral examination to ensure clear audio capture.

questions.question_text: What happens if a candidate arrives late for an oral test?
options: They can start late with no penalty
They are admitted to the next session
They are not admitted to the test
They can enter but must finish early
questions.explanation: According to the test regulations, candidates arriving after the start time for an oral exam will not be admitted.
